What if you sat with your legs crossed every day?
Lots of people cross their legs at work, in class or on the couch. It feels comfy and polite. Most people do it without even thinking.

But here's the twist. It doesn't cause varicose veins, that's a myth, but it can raise your blood pressure for a moment and press on a nerve, making your foot tingle! Doctors say switch sides and stand up every half hour or so.
